About

Welcome!

I am a full professor of Structural Mechanics and Acoustics at the Laboratoire de Mécanique, Acoustique, Contrôle et Calcul Scientifique (MACS) of Le Cnam in Paris.

I am an enthusiastic and avid user of the Typst markup language and the Julia programming language. I turn a good part of my research and teaching material into open-source tools.

Research

Research interests

Identification

Inverse problems

Estimating unknown excitation sources from vibration measurements with Bayesian methods.
→
Control

Vibration control

Reducing structural vibrations and noise through passive and active strategies.
→
Modelling

Vibro-acoustic modeling

Predicting how structures vibrate and radiate sound, from analytical models to numerical simulation.
→
